name: TSK-001 - Next.js App Router & TypeScript Project Initialization
Description:
Set up fresh Next.js project using App Router and TypeScript with strict linting rules. Expectation: Project compiles cleanly with no warnings and includes base folder structure (/app, /components, /lib, /hooks, /types).

Acceptance Criteria:
- Next.js 14+ App Router initialized with TypeScript
- Strict ESLint and Prettier configuration established
- Core folder directory structured (/app/(dashboard), /components/ui, /lib/api)
- Zero build errors or lint warnings on initial run

name: TSK-002 - Base UI Theme Tokens & Global Provider Setup
Description:
Configure global CSS, theme tokens, typography, and color palette matching Konn3ct design system. Expectation: Dark/Light mode support setup with reusable theme variables.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Color palette tokens (Primary, Neutral, Danger, Warning, Success) configured
- Typography scales and font families imported and configured
- Global CSS reset and Tailwind/CSS variables initialized
- Theme Provider wrapper components created and verified

name: TSK-003 - Dashboard Shell & Navigation Layout Components
Description:
Build responsive admin dashboard shell including sidebar navigation, top header, breadcrumbs, and user badge. Expectation: Sidebar collapses cleanly on smaller screens (tablet view) without breaking layout.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Responsive sidebar with active route highlighting
- Top bar with admin profile dropdown and notification indicator
- Dynamic breadcrumb navigation matching current App Router route
- Mobile/Tablet drawer collapse toggle implemented and smooth transition verified

name: TSK-004 - Auth Session Context & State Provider
Description:
Create authentication state provider to store current admin session details, access tokens, and role entitlements. Expectation: Auth state persists properly and auto-refreshes tokens safely.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Auth Context Provider wrapping App root
- Support for token storage (HTTP-only cookies / secure memory)
- Helper hooks (useAdminAuth, useHasPermission) exposed for components
- Automatic session timeout listener configured

name: TSK-005 - Next.js Middleware for Admin Route & RBAC Protection
Description:
Write Next.js middleware to intercept unauthorized requests and enforce role-based route access. Expectation: Unauthenticated users redirected to login; non-super-admins blocked from restricted routes.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Next.js middleware checking session token on all /admin/* routes
- Unauthenticated users redirected to /login with return URL query param
- RBAC permission check blocking access to /admin/audit-logs if role != SuperAdmin
- 403 Forbidden page rendered gracefully for unauthorized routes

name: TSK-006 - Users List Page Shell & Filter Bar UI
Description:
Build page shell for User Management including search input, status filters (Active, Suspended, Banned), and role dropdowns. Expectation: Responsive filter bar with clean debounced inputs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Search input with 300ms debounce handler
- Role filter dropdown (Host, Participant, Moderator, OrgAdmin)
- Account status filter tabs (All, Active, Suspended, Banned)
- Clear filters button resetting form state

name: TSK-007 - Users Paginated Data Table Component
Description:
Build reusable server-side paginated table component for user listing. Expectation: Smooth loading skeletons, sorting controls, and error states.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Data table renders Name, Email, Role, Status Badge, Join Date, and Actions button
- Server-side pagination controls (Page size selector: 10, 25, 50, 100)
- Column sorting headers (Name, Join Date, Status) triggering API refetch
- Empty state and loading skeleton loaders implemented

name: TSK-008 - User Profile Details Slide-Over Drawer Component
Description:
Build slide-over drawer component displaying comprehensive user details when clicking a table row. Expectation: Shows profile summary, meeting history list, and active subscriptions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Drawer opens smoothly when user row is selected
- Displays User ID, Full Name, Email, Verification Status, and Registration Date
- Tabbed interface within drawer: Overview, Meeting History, Subscriptions
- Close button and background backdrop click-to-close behavior verified

name: TSK-009 - User Suspend & Unsuspend Modal Component
Description:
Build modal component to handle user suspension/unsuspension with compulsory reason input field. Expectation: Prevents action until reason is provided.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Modal opens on selecting Suspend Account action
- Displays warning notice with user name and email
- Compulsory text area for Reason for Suspension (min 10 characters)
- Submit button disabled until valid reason is entered
- API call executes and updates user badge status in table dynamically

name: TSK-010 - User Ban & Force Logout Action Modal
Description:
Build confirmation modal for severe action: Ban User & Invalidate Sessions. Expectation: Requires explicit confirmation typing (e.g. type BAN) before executing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Modal triggers for Ban User & Force Logout
- Requires admin to type CONFIRM BAN into text field to enable action button
- Submits API request to revoke all active tokens and mark user banned
- Success notification toast displayed and table row state refreshed

name: TSK-011 - Organizations List & Detail View Page
Description:
Build Organization Management page displaying enterprise/institutional accounts. Expectation: Shows Org Name, Admin Owner, Seat Count, Plan Tier, and Status.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Paginated list of registered Organizations
- Org detail drawer showing seat allocation and admin contact
- Option to edit allocated seat limits or plan tier
- Filter by plan type (Enterprise, School, Community)

name: TSK-012 - Payment Transaction Log Table UI
Description:
Build transaction table for viewing all payment attempts (Subscriptions, Events, Replays). Expectation: Table shows Transaction Ref, User, Amount, Currency, Gateway, Status, and Timestamp.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Server-side paginated table for transactions
- Status badges: Success (green), Pending (amber), Failed (red)
- Filter by Payment Type (Subscription, Paid Event, Paid Replay)
- Filter by Gateway (Paystack, Stripe, Direct Transfer)

name: TSK-013 - Transaction Detail Drawer & Webhook Payload Viewer
Description:
Create slide-over drawer to inspect a specific transaction and its gateway webhook log. Expectation: Displays JSON payload of gateway responses for troubleshooting failed payments.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Slide-over opens on row click
- Displays Gateway Transaction Reference, Error Codes, and Raw Webhook JSON response
- Syntax-highlighted JSON viewer component for webhook logs
- Copy-to-clipboard button for Reference ID and Error Code

name: TSK-014 - Manual Comp Access Grant Modal Component
Description:
Build modal allowing admins to manually grant complimentary access to a Paid Event or Paid Replay. Expectation: Compulsory selection of Event/Replay ID and Audit Reason.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Searchable dropdown for Paid Events and Paid Replay videos
- Expiry date selector for granted access
- Mandatory Reason for Grant text field
- Triggers entitlement API call and emits audit log event

name: TSK-015 - Entitlement Revocation Action Modal Component
Description:
Build modal to revoke a granted entitlement or paid replay access from a user. Expectation: Prompts for confirmation and immediate revocation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Displays active entitlement details to be revoked
- Mandatory Reason for Revocation text area
- Action button invalidates user access token for that specific media
- Success toast notification displayed

name: TSK-016 - Active Meetings Real-Time Summary Grid
Description:
Build real-time overview grid showing count of Active Rooms, Total Live Participants, and SFU Server Load. Expectation: Auto-refreshes data every 10 seconds.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Overview KPI metrics cards (Active Meetings, Total Participants, Total Bandwidth)
- Grid layout displaying live room cards with host info and duration
- Polling mechanism (10s interval) or WebSocket connection for live data
- Visual indicator showing Live Data Auto-Refreshing

name: TSK-017 - WebRTC Stream Quality Diagnostics Inspector Component
Description:
Build detailed WebRTC inspection modal for a specific live meeting. Expectation: Charts showing bitrate, packet loss percentage, and jitter stats.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Modal opens when selecting a live meeting room
- Real-time line chart for Audio/Video Bitrate
- Packet Loss percentage meter (Flags amber > 2%, red > 5%)
- Jitter metric display and server node connection status

name: TSK-018 - Live Meeting Participant List & Connection State Inspector
Description:
Build table inside meeting inspector showing list of connected participants and their individual media states. Expectation: Shows client type, network quality indicator, and audio/video state.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Table listing participant Name, Join Time, Network Quality (1-5 bars), Audio (Muted/Unmuted), Video (On/Off)
- Indicates client platform (Web, Android, iOS)
- Option to trigger remote reconnect command for troubleshooting

name: TSK-019 - AI Services Job Queue Monitor UI
Description:
Build dashboard view monitoring background AI processing jobs (Transcripts, Meeting Summaries, Action Points). Expectation: Clear status indicators for Pending, Processing, Failed, and Completed jobs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Job queue table showing Job ID, Meeting ID, Job Type, Status, Duration, and Error Message
- Filter jobs by Status (Failed, Pending, Processing)
- Retry Job action button for failed AI summary tasks

name: TSK-020 - Diagnostic Snapshot Export Action
Description:
Implement feature to package current meeting metrics, WebRTC stats, and error logs into a JSON file download. Expectation: One-click export for developer handoff.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Export Diagnostic Snapshot button on meeting inspector
- Generates sanitized JSON payload containing room state, server logs, and WebRTC metrics
- Downloads .json file named konn3ct-diag-{meetingId}-{timestamp}.json

name: TSK-021 - Recording Storage Table & Metadata Inspector
Description:
Build table listing all platform recordings with file size, duration, host ID, and storage tier (Active / Archived). Expectation: Shows lifecycle status and total storage consumed.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Paginated table of recordings with search by Meeting Title or Host ID
- Displays Storage Tier badge (Hot/Cold Storage) and Expiry Date
- Storage usage banner showing total GB consumed across system

name: TSK-022 - Break Glass Recording Access Security Protocol Modal
Description:
Build modal to handle emergency admin viewing of private recordings under strict audit controls (Volume 10). Expectation: Requires 2FA confirmation or explicit justification before generating temporary stream URL.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Request Access button triggers Break Glass Security Protocol modal
- Requires entering mandatory legal/support justification ticket ID
- Prompts admin for password re-verification
- Emits high-priority Audit Event (AUDIT_BREAK_GLASS_RECORDING_ACCESS)
- Generates 15-minute expiring signed URL for playback

name: TSK-023 - GDPR Data Deletion & Storage Lifecycle Action Modal
Description:
Build action modal for hard-deleting recordings and associated media files. Expectation: Double-confirmation modal with file size recovery calculation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Modal confirms permanent deletion of recording, transcript, and AI summary
- Requires typing DELETE RECORDING to enable execution
- Calls purge API and removes object storage file
- Updates UI and table state immediately

name: TSK-024 - AI Summary & Transcript Moderation Panel
Description:
Build panel to review and moderate AI-generated meeting summaries attached to public/paid replays. Expectation: Editable summary text area and publish status toggle.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Displays AI Summary text, Key Takeaways list, and Action Items
- Admin can edit text to fix errors before public replay publishing
- Approve & Publish Replay Summary toggle button
- Flag summary content as inappropriate action

name: TSK-025 - Primary KPI Dashboard Header Component
Description:
Build executive KPI cards component displaying headline metrics: Free Users and Paid Users (Volume 5 Doctrine). Expectation: Visual cards with period-over-period percentage growth.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Card 1: Total Free Users + MTD Growth % + Trend Sparkline
- Card 2: Total Paid Users + MTD Growth % + Trend Sparkline
- Visual badge indicating North Star Metric
- Tooltip explaining metric definition on hover

name: TSK-026 - Usage Trend Charts (Meetings  Replays  Subscriptions)
Description:
Integrate charting library (e.g. Recharts) to render line and bar charts for key activity drivers. Expectation: Interactive charts with tooltip data inspection.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Line Chart: Meetings Hosted vs Participant Join Trends (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)
- Bar Chart: Subscription Upgrades vs Cancelation Trends
- Area Chart: Paid Replay Revenue Trends
- Empty data state handling and loading indicators verified

name: TSK-027 - Country Growth Breakdown Widget
Description:
Build widget displaying user distribution and conversion rate by country. Expectation: Table and map view for international expansion tracking.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Country list showing Free Users, Paid Users, and Free-to-Paid % per country
- Search/filter by country code
- Visual status indicator for Country Hub readiness

name: TSK-028 - Analytics Global Date & Region Filter Toolbar
Description:
Build sticky top filter toolbar for adjusting date ranges and regions across all dashboard analytics. Expectation: Changes update all charts simultaneously.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Preset date range buttons (Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, Year to Date, Custom Range)
- Geographic region dropdown filter (Global, Africa, Europe, North America)
- Custom Date Picker modal
- URL query parameter sync for bookmarking report views

name: TSK-029 - Immutable Audit Log Table View UI
Description:
Build read-only Audit Log table for Super Admins. Expectation: Strict read-only table displaying all system state modifications.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Table displays Timestamp, Admin Email/ID, Action Type, Target Entity, IP Address, and Status
- No edit or delete action buttons exist anywhere in this view
- Export to CSV button for compliance auditing
- Color-coded action badges (USER_BAN, PAYMENT_OVERRIDE, BREAK_GLASS)

name: TSK-030 - Audit Log Advanced Search & Filter Toolbar
Description:
Build search and filter bar for the Audit Log view. Expectation: Filter by Admin ID, Action Category, Date Range, and Keyword search.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Admin user autocomplete search input
- Action Category filter dropdown (User Management, Financial Overrides, Content Access, System Security)
- Search payload text input
- Reset filter controls

name: TSK-031 - Audit Log Payload Event Details Modal Component
Description:
Build modal component to view full JSON event payload of an audit log entry. Expectation: Displays exact metadata captured at the time of admin action.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Opens when clicking an audit log entry row
- Displays formatted JSON of pre-action and post-action state
- Displays User Agent string, Request IP, and Request Session ID
- Copy payload string button
